sentences.text: Revenue compounded at 14.7% a year from $96.6 billion in FY2017 to $331.8 billion in FY2026 [F1][F10][F221].

The path was a step change rather than a straight line: growth ran 17.5% in FY2021 and 18.0% in FY2022, fell to 6.9% in FY2023, then recovered to 15.7% in FY2024 and 17.8% in FY2026 [D205][D258][D311][D364][D472].
The FY2023 slowdown came as revenue grew only 7% with More Personal Computing declining, driven by Windows and Devices [P39].
The FY2026 reacceleration was driven by Microsoft Cloud, with Intelligent Cloud revenue up on Azure and Productivity and Business Processes up on Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud [P17].
Microsoft Cloud supplied 16.2pp of the 17.8% revenue growth in FY2026 and reached 64.6% of revenue [D568][D472][D566].
Server products and cloud services revenue rose 31% on Azure and other cloud services, which grew 41% on demand across all workloads [P12].
Microsoft 365 Commercial products and cloud services added 5.1pp in FY2026, and More Personal Computing subtracted 0.2pp as XBOX fell 7.1% [D649][D942][D712].
The XBOX decline reflected lower content and services and a 29% drop in hardware volume [P10].
Operating income grew 20.8% against 17.8% revenue growth, an incremental margin of 53.3%, and operating costs grew 10.3pp slower than revenue [D473][D472][D498][D499].
Operating margin reached 46.8% in FY2026, above the 41.7% window median and the 30.1% window low [F50][D975][D973].
Gross margin slipped 0.9pp to 67.9%, below the 68.2% window median, as cost of revenue took 0.9pp off operating margin [D486][F30][D981][D500].
Intelligent Cloud gross margin percentage fell on continued AI infrastructure investment and mix shift to Azure, offset by Azure efficiency gains [P11].
In FY2026 net margin of 40.3% sat 6.5pp below the 46.8% operating margin, with the 19.4% effective tax rate and $10.7 billion of other income both in play [F70][F50][D1023][D458][X124].
Operating cash flow of $182.9 billion was 1.37x net income, in line with the 1.34x window median [F100][D459][D1013].
The increase was primarily due to more cash received from customers and less cash paid for income taxes, offset by more paid to suppliers [P1].
Free cash flow fell 6.5% to $67.0 billion, a 20.2% margin and the window low, as capex of $115.9 billion reached 34.9% of revenue and 3.38x D&A [D478][F120][D456][D982][F110][D455][D461].
Investing cash use rose $66.9 billion, primarily on a $51.4 billion increase in property and equipment additions [P1].
Net cash was $72.9 billion, or 22.0% of revenue, against a -7.2% peer median and in the 83rd percentile of six software peers [D465][D466][D1007][D1006].
Total debt fell 6.6% to $40.3 billion while cash and investments rose 2.9% to $113.2 billion [D495][D464][D494][D463].
Buybacks of $22.3 billion plus dividends of $26.4 billion used 72.7% of free cash flow, and the diluted share count fell 0.2% [X147][X157][D468][D493].
The current ratio of 1.23x is the window low, but the net cash position and $113.2 billion of investments leave ample liquidity [F200][D991][D463].
Free cash flow ran below 80% of net income in FY2025 and FY2026, at 0.70x and 0.50x, against a 0.91x window median [R1][D406][D460][D990].
The gap is capex-led rather than earnings-led, so the flag matters as a signal of how much of the AI build the cash flow statement now absorbs [R1].
Short-term investments were not reported in FY2017 though reported in FY2018, so cash and investments and net cash for that year omit them [R6][X158].
This is a data-quality flag: net cash as a share of revenue and cash and investments growth across the FY2017 gap should not be read as a trend [R6].
Whether free cash flow margin recovers above the 20.2% FY2026 window low or stays below the 30.3% median will show in the FY2027 cash flow statement [D982][D984].
Whether capex as a share of revenue falls back from 34.9% or holds above the 22.9% FY2025 level will appear in the FY2027 investing section [D455][D401].
Whether Intelligent Cloud operating margin recovers from 41.3% toward the 44.3% FY2021 level will show in the FY2027 segment results [D963][D958].
